blockingImprovementsAccepted: semantic rows require source path/hash/line span/extractor version/authority disposition
examples/generated evidence/quoted anti-patterns/historical/superseded text require explicit non-authority disposition
unresolved authority-relevant rows fail-closed for promotion/cutover/equivalence/owner adoption/deletion/canonical write/SSOT adoption
current validator/evidence lane becomes curated regression fixtures
counterexamples: unresolved rows should block promotion but not ingestion
not every proposal packet should become a fixture; only accepted decisions, named negatives, and boundary claims
authorityDisposition must not be mistaken for approval authority

gen2B.finalRecommendedRoute: Freeze validator lane as bounded acceptance evidence and regression fixture source. Start minimal md ontology -> append-only JSONL facts -> deterministic projection/reducer route.
counterexamplesAgainstCurrentRoute: proposal packets can pass locally but leave no single queryable corpus map
PASS-but-BLOCK lanes create false progress optics
counterexamplesAgainstMdOntologyRoute: large ontology can become second policy repo
mechanical extraction can create false authority from examples/quotes/generated/historical text
JSONL without exact spans/hash/extractor version is worse than markdown
strengthening: metadata flags must be reducer-enforced non-promotion
proposal validators become regression fixtures, not parallel authority islands
